description: Shapes taken from real Express codebases. Every one of these silently dropped taint or hid a control until the engine was run against code nobody wrote for it. Fixture-only testing never surfaced any of them. Also contains reflected XSS: the same caller-supplied value comes back out in a text/html response body. One source, two sinks, two weaknesses, one policy.

expected.note: destructured request data; the seed is req.query, and the binding is tainted from it
shorthand property; needs the checker's shorthand value accessor
nested destructuring off req itself; the binding must carry its property path or no source matches
the lookup result is echoed into a text/html body
